WITH labour AS (SELECT w.project_id, SUM(w.hours * c.hourly_rate_gbp) AS labour_cost
FROM site.work_logs w JOIN site.crew c ON c.crew_id = w.crew_id
WHERE w.project_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY w.project_id), mats AS (SELECT project_id, SUM(quantity * unit_cost_gbp) AS materials_cost
FROM site.material_orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered' GROUP BY project_id)
SELECT p.project_name, p.contract_value_gbp - COALESCE(l.labour_cost, 0) - COALESCE(m.materials_cost, 0) AS gross_margin_gbp
FROM site.projects p LEFT JOIN labour l ON l.project_id = p.project_id LEFT JOIN mats m ON m.project_id = p.project_id
WHERE p.status <> 'cancelled'
ORDER BY gross_margin_gbp

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN CAST(julianday(actual_end_date) - julianday(planned_end_date) AS INTEGER) <= 7 THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS on_time_rate
FROM site.projects WHERE status = 'complete' AND substr(CAST(actual_end_date AS TEXT), 1, 7) = '2026-10'

SELECT SUM(w.hours * c.hourly_rate_gbp) AS rework_cost_gbp
FROM site.work_logs w JOIN site.crew c ON c.crew_id = w.crew_id WHERE w.task_type = 'rework' AND w.crew_id = 'C01' AND substr(CAST(w.work_date AS TEXT), 1, 7) = '2026-07'
